verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog says engineers can use the Linear mobile app to review code changes, comment on specific lines, and iterate with Linear Agent, which matches the story element for element. Supporting docs show Linear Agent writing code in cloud coding sessions via Claude Code/Codex and Guided Reviews rendering diffs. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the mobile line-comment and agent-iteration workflow beyond a single changelog sentence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
